site.name: Paymaster Mine
overview: Paymaster Mine is a documented historic Boulder County tungsten property associated with the paired Paymaster-Wheelman workings in the Boulder Canyon area.

timeline.text: State and federal district records document the Paymaster and Wheelman workings as part of the Boulder County tungsten-mining landscape.

moreHistory: Federal mineral records preserve the Paymaster-Wheelman property near 40.00444, -105.37417. Remnant treats this coordinate as the parent historic property locality rather than claiming that one mapped tunnel represents every working in the complex.

sourceReferences.title: Colorado Geological Survey MI-04 — Tungsten Mines of Colorado
